items.title: Turning Point Action hits the ground in New Hampshire for a key Senate race
items.brief: One year after Charlie Kirk’s assassination , the organization he founded for young conservatives is building out its political operation in a purple state that has often evaded Republicans’ grasp at the federal level.

items.title: Ukraine defies Trump and launches one of its biggest drone attacks on Russia this year
items.brief: Ukraine launched one of its biggest drone attacks this year on Russia overnight on Saturday, hitting a key oil terminal in defiance of US President Donald Trump’s demand it stop hitting Russian energy infrastructure.

items.title: Nellis Air Force Base: Service member dies after rappelling fall at a UT San Antonio game
items.brief: A military service member has died after he fell hard as he rappelled from the ceiling to midfield before a University of Texas at San Antonio football game, where the military was honored.

items.title: Nine days before Israeli elections, Trump finally endorses Netanyahu
items.brief: With just over a week to go until Israel’s election day, President Donald Trump finally gave the full-throated endorsement that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had long sought.

items.title: ‘These are really tough times’: House Republicans confront voter fury over Trump’s Washington in final midterm stretch
items.brief: GOP operatives conducting a focus group in a traditionally red Midwestern state this month were taken aback by what they heard from their own party’s voters.

items.title: France wakes up to wreckage of a night of rioting after protests turned violent
items.brief: Communities across France were reeling on Sunday following one of the most violent nights of unrest in recent years, after protests over the cost of living and public services investment descended into rioting –…

items.title: Several dead after major fire breaks out at Canada military base
items.brief: Several people are dead or injured following a major fire at one of Canada’s busiest military bases on Saturday.

items.title: Man shot and killed on subway platform in midtown Manhattan after argument
items.brief: New York (AP) — An argument on a subway platform in midtown Manhattan turned deadly Saturday, leaving one man fatally shot and train service disrupted.
